title: SentinelCut Detection Object
description: Authoritative schema for a single profanity detection. Person 1's AI pipeline must output arrays of this shape. Person 2's backend stores/serves this shape. Person 3's renderer consumes 'active' detections in this shape. Person 4's frontend renders and edits this shape.

id.description: Unique ID for this detection within the job, e.g. 'det_001'.

word.description: The word exactly as it appeared in the raw transcript, before normalization.

normalized.description: The word after normalization (repeat-collapsing, leetspeak mapping, separator stripping) used for dictionary matching.

language.description: Which word list this match came from. Not the detected language of the sentence as a whole.

severity.description: Used for optional filtering in the timeline editor.

start.description: Start time in seconds, from word-level Whisper timestamps.

source.description: Which stage of the detection pipeline produced this match. 'custom' = user-supplied word list at upload. 'manual' = added by user in the timeline editor after AI processing.

confidence.description: 1.0 for exact dictionary matches; lower for fuzzy/regex matches. Manual additions default to 1.0.

replacement.description: MVP supports beep and mute only. Custom sound / AI voice are post-MVP enum values to add later.

status.description: 'active' = will be censored on render. 'removed' = user deleted this detection via PATCH. 'added' = user manually created it via POST.
